outputs.explanation: The cell death bar chart in panel A shows mean ± s.d. of three independent experiments as bars with error bars, but no individual data points from the three experiments are overlaid.
Panel B's cell death bar chart displays bars with error bars (representing replicate variability) but does not overlay the individual data points behind these averages.
The cell death bar chart shows mean ± s.d. of three experiments at each time point as bars with error bars, without displaying the individual replicate values.
The cell death bar chart in panel D shows averaged values with error bars but does not show the individual data points underlying these averages.
